name: OpenClaw main runtime
does: ZeroBot/ProtoCosmoBot runtime, Gateway, Telegram routing, tools, cron scheduler, sessions, memory/search, and local OpenAI-compatible proxy.

name: OpenClaw Gateway HTTP endpoints
does: Provides authenticated local /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses for OmegaClaw and smoke harnesses.

name: Telegram channel integration
does: Routes Ben direct chat, Protobots groups, scheduled-updates, and BotBotChats with group-specific prompts.

name: Tectonic LaTeX compiler
does: Compiles LaTeX .tex files to PDF when pdflatex/xelatex/lualatex are absent.

name: Ollama local LLM runtime
does: Local LLM fallback for provider/billing/network failures.

name: Ollama keepalive cron
does: Checks Ollama API every 5 minutes and starts ollama serve if down.

name: OpenClaw intent-model-router plugin
does: Cost/intent-aware model routing; sends routine work to GLM and substantive/OmegaClaw prompts to GPT-5.5.

name: Agent recovery repositories
does: Sanitized private GitHub recovery snapshots for ZeroBot/OpenClaw and ProtoMegaBot/OmegaClaw.

name: Channel watchdog
does: Scans Telegram bot conversations for dropped continuations, missing attachments, stock acknowledgements, runaway bot-bot chatter, and unsurfaced completions.

name: ProtoMegaBot / OmegaClaw local runtime
does: PeTTa/OmegaClaw-based ProtoMegaBot/ProtomegaTron runtime using local SWI/PeTTa/ChromaDB/embeddings and OpenClaw as LLM backend.

name: OmegaClaw watchdog
does: Checks ProtoMegaBot Telegram supervisor and restarts it if down.

name: Local SWI-Prolog for OmegaClaw
does: Required Prolog runtime for PeTTa/OmegaClaw with Janus/process/filesex/pcre/uuid support.

name: ThreadKeeper subagent system
head: 52a9bc9
does: OmegaClaw-side subagent, queued task, worker, and audit infrastructure with extensive hardening.

name: GoalChainer / deontic-directive runtime
does: Norm/goal/task decision layer using deontic/directive runtime and heuristic PLN-style belief grading, tested through non-live gates.

name: QMD semantic search
does: Local semantic search layer for memory/projects/library/catalog; current CLI path needs recheck before relying on it.
